cited.entity: industry — global EV battery usage, all chemistries (CATL, BYD, LGES, CALB, Gotion, Panasonic, EVE, SK On, SVOLT, REPT)
cited.metric: Global EV/PHEV/HEV battery usage (batteries in vehicles registered worldwide) and supplier market share
cited.value: Total 725.2 GWh, +20.4% YoY (July alone 116.0 GWh, +22.1%). CATL 289.6 GWh / 39.9% share (+26.6% YoY; share 38.0%→39.9%); BYD 106.7 GWh / 14.7% (+4.7%; 16.9%→14.7%); LG Energy Solution 60.3 GWh / 8.3% (+4.5%; 9.6%→8.3%); CALB 37.3 GWh (+34.3%); Gotion 34.0 GWh (+44.2%); Panasonic 26.2 GWh / 3.6% (+7.6%; 4.0%→3.6%); EVE 25.0 GWh (+53.1%); SK On 22.3 GWh / 3.1% (−9.8%; 4.1%→3.1%); SVOLT 18.9 GWh (+39.1%); REPT 16.9 GWh (+118.5%, new entrant displacing Sunwoda). Seven Chinese suppliers in the top 10 = 72.8% combined (+3.1pp). CATL+BYD combined SHARE 54.6% (−0.3pp from 54.9%). LFP share of global usage 51.6%→56.1%; average pack size 34.5→38.6 kWh.
cited.source_name: SNE Research — Press Release (Insight), "From Jan to Jul 2026, Global EV Battery Usage Posted 725.2GWh" (English edition; data from its Global EV and Battery Monthly Tracker, August 2026)
cited.notes: BACKDROP ONLY — this is all-chemistry xEV battery usage (EV+PHEV+HEV, 80 countries aggregated), NOT solid-state. Nothing in it can be read across to solid-state share. Verifier fixes applied: CATL+BYD 54.6% is a SHARE, not GWh (the researcher wrote '54.6% GWh'); label the scope 'EV incl. PHEV/HEV', not BEV-only. The cited English URL (id 727) is SNE's own English twin of the Korean original at /en/insight/release_view/726/page/0, which carries Korean body text despite the /en/ path — both show 'Registration Date 2026-09-07' in the page body. Do NOT publish per-company shares for CALB, Gotion, EVE, SVOLT or REPT: SNE's text gives only GWh and YoY for those five; the circulating 5.1%/4.7%/3.5%/2.6%/2.3% figures come from CnEVPost reading SNE's chart image. CnEVPost is the downstream re-report — cite SNE.

cited.entity: industry — global EV battery usage EXCLUDING China (CATL, LGES, BYD, Panasonic, SK On, Samsung SDI, Gotion, SVOLT, CALB, EVE)
cited.metric: Global (ex-China) EV/PHEV/HEV battery usage and supplier market share
cited.source_name: SNE Research — Press Release (Insight), "Global (Ex-China) EV Battery Usage in January-July 2026 Reaches 316.2 GWh, Up 25.8% Year-on-Year"
cited.notes: BACKDROP ONLY, all chemistries. This is the more honest denominator for LGES / Samsung SDI / SK On / Panasonic, and it is the only free SNE release that gives a 2026 Samsung SDI number (SDI is absent from the China-inclusive top 10). The −10.4pp collapse in combined Korean share is the single most load-bearing share datapoint for the Korean names. Verifier fixes: CATL+BYD 44.6% is a SHARE not GWh (= 140.9 GWh); scope is xEV incl. hybrids. Shares for Gotion/SVOLT/CALB/EVE are not given in the release — do not compute and attribute them to SNE. 'Registration Date 2026-09-09' is in the page body, not a search snippet. Serves as the negative control proving the 725.2 GWh figure is genuinely China-inclusive.
